name: @xyne/xyne-cli
description: Xyne CLI - A powerful AI assistant in your terminal with file operations, bash mode, drag-and-drop support, and multi-provider AI integration

scripts.dev: bun run build:voice:current && XYNE_ENGINE=native bun run src/index.ts
scripts.dev:native: bun run build:voice:current && XYNE_NATIVE_HARNESS=1 bun run src/index.ts
scripts.build:npm: bun run changelog && bun run build:clean && bun run build:protocol && bun run build:lib && bun run build:compile && bun run build:webpack-bundle && bun run build:voice:current && bun run build:binary:release && bun run build:npm-dist && bun run build:launcher
scripts.build:binaries: bun run changelog && bun run build:clean && bun run build:protocol && bun run build:lib && bun run build:compile && bun run build:webpack-bundle && bun run build:voice:current && bun run build:binary:release && bun run build:launcher
scripts.build:clean: rm -rf dist dist-lib dist-native binaries temp-build packages/protocol/dist packages/xyne-cli-*/bundled-extensions
scripts.build:npm-dist: mkdir -p dist && cp -r temp-build/* dist/ && mkdir -p dist/src/agent/themes && cp -r src/agent/themes/* dist/src/agent/themes/ && node scripts/copy-patched-packages.js && rm -rf temp-build
scripts.build:binary:prepare: node scripts/ensure-build-optional-deps.js && node scripts/patch-worker-inline.js && node scripts/patch-opentui-render-loop.js
scripts.build:binary:release: bun run build:binary:prepare && mkdir -p binaries && bun run build:binary:linux-x64 && bun run build:binary:linux-arm && bun run build:binary:macos-intel && bun run build:binary:macos-arm && bun run build:binary:windows && node scripts/copy-binaries-to-packages.js
scripts.build:binary:all: bun run build:binary:prepare && mkdir -p binaries && bun run build:binary:linux-x64 && bun run build:binary:linux-arm && bun run build:binary:macos-intel && bun run build:binary:macos-arm && bun run build:binary:windows
scripts.build:voice:macos-arm: cargo build --manifest-path sidecar/Cargo.toml --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin && mkdir -p binaries && cp sidecar/target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/xyne-voice binaries/xyne-voice-macos-arm
scripts.build:voice:macos-intel: cargo build --manifest-path sidecar/Cargo.toml --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin && mkdir -p binaries && cp sidecar/target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/xyne-voice binaries/xyne-voice-macos-intel
scripts.build:voice:linux-x64: cargo build --manifest-path sidecar/Cargo.toml --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && mkdir -p binaries && cp sidecar/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/xyne-voice binaries/xyne-voice-linux-x64
scripts.build:voice:linux-arm64: cargo build --manifest-path sidecar/Cargo.toml --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && mkdir -p binaries && cp sidecar/target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/xyne-voice binaries/xyne-voice-linux-arm64
scripts.build:voice:windows: cargo build --manifest-path sidecar/Cargo.toml --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && mkdir -p binaries && cp sidecar/target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/xyne-voice.exe binaries/xyne-voice-windows.exe
scripts.test:harness: bun test scripts/eval-runner-support.test.ts scripts/eval-session-trace.test.ts src/agent/bridge.interaction.test.ts src/agent/prompts/generated.test.ts src/agent/runtime/prompt-composition.test.ts src/agent/runtime/tool-heartbeat.test.ts src/agent/runtime/testing/llm-request-capture.test.ts src/agent/runtime/interaction-trace.test.ts src/agent/tools/review-prompt/index.test.ts src/agent/tools/session-name.test.ts src/agent/tools/tool-error-recovery.test.ts src/core/cli/get-turn-error.test.ts src/core/cli/llm-request-wire.integration.test.ts src/core/cli/midstream-retry.integration.test.ts src/core/cli/headless-prompt.integration.test.ts src/core/cli/headless-permission-denied.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:acceptance: bun run build:pi-public-package-fixtures && bun test src/agent/kernel/ src/agent/plugins/ src/agent/profiles/ src/agent/adapters/ src/agent/runtime/native-harness-selector.test.ts src/agent/runtime/kernel-backed-runtime.test.ts src/agent/runtime/native-scope-registry.test.ts src/agent/runtime/shared-kernel.test.ts tests/golden-fidelity.test.ts src/agent/session-import/
scripts.test:guardrails: bun test src/agent/permissions/permissions.isolation.test.ts src/agent/tools/agent-modes-restrictions.test.ts src/agent/tools/terminal/terminal.test.ts src/agent/tools/phase4-contracts.test.ts src/agent/permissions/tool-diff-preview.test.ts src/agent/permissions/classifier.test.ts src/agent/guarded-subscribe.test.ts src/core/cli/headless-permission-denied.integration.test.ts src/agent/plugins/core-tools/tools.guardrail.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:tool-contracts: bun test src/agent/tools/sessions.test.ts src/agent/tools/skill/first-turn.test.ts src/agent/tools/phase4-contracts.test.ts src/agent/tools/terminal/lifecycle.test.ts src/agent/tools/lsp-shutdown.test.ts src/agent/tools/mcp/progressive-discovery.test.ts src/agent/tools/mcp/effects.test.ts src/agent/tools/vespa-memory/contracts.test.ts src/agent/tools/spaces/contracts.test.ts
scripts.test:privacy: bun test src/agent/privacy.test.ts src/agent/tools/notify.test.ts src/agent/tools/truncation/truncation.test.ts src/agent/tools/mcp/effects.test.ts src/agent/tools/spaces/effects.test.ts src/agent/tools/session-summary.test.ts src/agent/tools/vespa-memory/capture.test.ts
scripts.generated:check: bun run prompts:check && bun run subagents:check && bun run docs:check && bun run swift:check
scripts.cli:update: bun run build && npm uninstall -g @xyne/xyne-cli && npm install -g .
scripts.release:native-tarball: bun run build && bun run build:native-tarball
scripts.build:release: bun run build:npm && bun run build:voice:release

author: Xyne Team
